This file documents the run_grants resource at the shell, one section per command. Every command is a subcommand of =run_grants=, and every section exports its own script into =projects/ores.shell/scripts/library/=. Loading a script runs that one command, so a failure names the command it came from.

* Commands

** =list=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 19A31B71-AD75-57B8-BBF2-0FC768F7F500
:END:

Reads one page of the collection. Nothing addresses it but the caller's tenant, so it is the read that shows what exists.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
run_grants list [--offset <n>] [--limit <n>] [--order <field>] [--desc]
#+end_example

It is addressed at =iam.v1.run_grants.list=.

#+name: run_grants-list
#+begin_src ores-shell :tangle run_grants-list.ores :exports none
run_grants list --limit 1
#+end_src

** =get=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 33AD7DE8-A75A-5E08-B273-739E88574AAD
:END:

Reads the one row its key addresses. A key states every identifying column, so a partial key is refused rather than answered with an arbitrary row.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
run_grants get <resource>
#+end_example

It is addressed at =iam.v1.run_grants.get=.

#+name: run_grants-get

#+end_src
